verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a named Biometric Liveness capability that checks the captured biometric data comes from a live person, and it is available via API, web flow and native SDKs. However, the evidence describes it only in generic fraud-reduction terms. Nothing names defenses against AI-generated faces, deepfakes or camera/virtual-camera injection. Missing for 10: named deepfake or AI-generated-face detection, documented camera-injection or virtual-camera defenses, technical detail on detection methods, and independent corroboration.
